pwDesc: Changing it signs out every other device.
tfaOnDesc: Every sign-in asks for a code from your phone.
tfaOffDesc: Only your password is asked now.
tfaKey: Add this key to an authenticator app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password…), then enter the 6-digit code.
sessDesc: You stay signed in on this device for 14 days.
everyDeviceDesc: Signs out everywhere, including this one.
lockDesc: Keeps your money private if someone picks up your phone.
lockOn: Ask to unlock when the app opens
lockHow: Uses your fingerprint, face or screen lock. It asks again when you come back after the time you choose below, and the app is hidden in the list of recent apps.
lockFail: The lock could not be turned on. Try again.
lockNone: This phone has no fingerprint, face or screen lock set up. Set one up in the phone's settings first.
lockWhenD: How long you can be away from the app before it asks again.
tfaDesc: A stolen password is not enough: every sign-in also asks for a 6-digit code from an app on your phone.
tfaRow: Ask for a code at sign-in
tfaCodeD: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
tfaOffD: Type your password to stop asking for a code.
rkDesc: If you forget the password, this key lets you choose a new one on the sign-in screen ("Forgot password?").
rkNudge: You have no recovery key yet. Make one now, so a forgotten password does not lock you out.
rkPwD: The old key stops working as soon as the new one is made.
rkPwD1: The key is shown once, right after this.
rkShow: Save this key now. It is shown only once. Keep it somewhere safe, away from this device: on paper or in a password manager.
